name: categorizer-agent

dependencies.name: expense-api
dependencies.description: Reads the household's category list to ground its suggestion.

description: Suggests a category for an expense from its free-text description, grounded in the caller's household's own category list. Stateless in effect — each suggestion stands alone — but keeps the standard per-caller conversation store. Never creates, edits or deletes anything; it only reads categories and answers with a suggestion the member can accept or override.
